## Service: Meta Ads
URL: https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/meta-ads/
Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns that bring qualified solar and real estate leads in Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Bhopal, Rewa and Satna. Lead forms, WhatsApp ads, CAPI tracking.
- Offer and audience first: We start from what makes a buyer act: subsidy savings for solar, price, location and possession date for property. Then we build audiences around it.
- Lead forms that filter: Instant forms with qualifying questions (monthly bill, roof type, budget, configuration) so your sales team calls fewer time-wasters.
- Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns: Ads that open a WhatsApp chat with you directly, with an instant auto-reply so no lead waits.
- Creative testing every week: Static, carousel, reels, UGC and AI avatar videos, tested in small budgets before we scale winners.
- Pixel and Conversions API: Server-side tracking so Meta optimises for real leads and site visits, not cheap form fills.
- Weekly reporting: Cost per lead, cost per qualified lead and what changed this week, in plain language.
Q: How much budget do I need to start Meta Ads?
A: Most local solar and real estate campaigns can start testing with ₹500 to ₹1,500 a day. We decide the final budget after looking at your city, ticket size and sales capacity.
Q: Lead form or WhatsApp, which works better?
A: Lead forms usually bring more volume; click-to-WhatsApp usually brings warmer conversations. We often run both and keep what gives the lower cost per qualified lead for your business.
Q: Do you make the ad creatives?
A: Yes. We write the copy and produce statics, carousels, reels and AI avatar videos. You only share your project or installation photos and approvals.

## Service: Google Ads
URL: https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/google-ads/
Google Search, Performance Max and YouTube campaigns for rooftop solar and real estate. Capture high-intent searches like 'solar panel installation near me' and '3 BHK in Gurugram'.
- High-intent keyword plans: City and locality level keywords, competitor terms where allowed, and long negative lists so you don't pay for jobs, DIY or free-panel searches.
- Landing pages that match: Each ad group lands on a page that answers the exact search, which improves Quality Score and lowers cost per click.
- Calls and WhatsApp tracked: Call extensions, call tracking and WhatsApp click tracking in GA4 so we optimise for conversations, not visits.
- Performance Max with guardrails: PMax for scale only after search is profitable, with brand exclusions and asset groups per project or service.
- YouTube for consideration: Short video ads for project walkthroughs and solar explainers, retargeted to people who searched.
- Monthly search term clean-up: We read the search terms report every week and cut waste fast.
Q: Is Google Ads better than Meta Ads for solar?
A: They do different jobs. Google catches people already searching, so leads are high intent but limited in volume. Meta creates demand. Most installers do best with both.
Q: Can you track phone calls from ads?
A: Yes. We set up call extensions, call conversion tracking and WhatsApp click events so you see exactly which keywords bring calls.
Q: Do you need access to my Google Ads account?
A: We work inside your own account so the data and history always stay yours.

URL: https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/ai-automation/
AI automation for solar and real estate sales teams: instant WhatsApp replies, lead routing, CRM updates, follow-up sequences and site-visit reminders.

Q: Can automation close sales by itself?
A: It handles speed, reminders and qualification. Your team still closes. Automation makes sure they only spend time on warm leads.

## Guides
- [Website Design Cost in Delhi NCR (2026): What Businesses Actually Pay and Why](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/website-design-cost-delhi-ncr/): In Delhi NCR, a standard 5 to 8 page business website usually costs somewhere between ₹10,000 and ₹60,000 as of November 2026, depending on whether it is template-based or custom, who writes the content and how much SEO setup is included. Add ₹3,000 to ₹15,000 a year for domain, hosting and basic upkeep, plus 18% GST on agency invoices. Kiran Growth School builds standard business websites in about 48 hours once your content is ready, with the scope and yearly costs written down upfront.
- [Solar Marketing in Noida: How Installers Can Win RWA and Factory Rooftop Projects](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/solar-marketing-agency-noida-rwa-factory-rooftop/): Noida installers win RWA and factory projects by running two separate funnels. Societies need a committee-ready proposal built around the PM Surya Ghar GHS/RWA assistance of ₹18,000 per kW for common facilities, while factories need a payback and bill-savings case, because commercial and industrial rooftops are outside PM Surya Ghar. Kiran Growth School builds both funnels with Google Search, Meta Ads, separate landing pages and WhatsApp follow-up.
